extensions.text: Made by others, they add to what you can do here. Each runs apart from your files and keys, with no internet, and does only what you allow.
extensions.addText: Anyone can make one. {name} reads it first and shows you what it asks, before anything is added.
extensions.addHint: The address of its folder, or of its page on GitHub.
extensions.right.draw: Show things of its own here
extensions.right.change: Change what it sees before it goes on
extensions.right.refuse: Stop an action, or ask you first
extensions.right.loosen: Let actions go ahead without asking you first
extensions.rightText.watch: All that is written in them, the files you share, and each action before it runs
extensions.rightText.loosen: Never a password or a payment, nor past a rule your organisation set
extensions.onceText: If something isn’t right since you added one
extensions.error.address: That isn’t the address of an extension.
extensions.error.fetch: It couldn’t be read from there.
extensions.error.format: It is made for another version.
extensions.error.name: Its name can only have lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
extensions.error.main: Its code must be a JavaScript file beside its extension.json.
extensions.error.rights: It asks for something extensions can’t do.
extensions.failed: {title} didn’t start, so it is off for now.
extensions.off: {title} kept failing, so it is turned off.
extensions.failing: It kept failing, so it was turned off.
extensions.safe: Safe mode: no extension runs during this visit.
extensions.confirmRemove: Remove {title}? What it kept goes with it.
